label: Editorial Collage
description: Original deterministic editorial collage family for culture, multi-source narrative, evidence montage, and recap scenes with embed-only asset rendering and explicit source captions.
avoidFor: scenes requiring proprietary screenshots, logos, or brand-faithful imagery
asset-free lessons where media placeholders would dominate the frame
metric dashboards requiring precise tables or time-series comparison

renderCost.notes: Layered DOM frames, caption surfaces, and embedded SVG assets add moderate browser rendering cost without network or video decode.

reducedMotion.notes: Reduced mode shortens layer travel, while static mode preserves final crop positions and source captions without randomized drift.

accessibility.notes: High-contrast cream and ink palette, bounded captions, fixed recap rail, and explicit placeholders preserve readable source status.

directorCompatibility.selectionReason: Choose when narration needs a culture-facing montage, multiple visible evidence sources, or a recap that compares source roles.
hardBlocks: requires more than four simultaneous source captions

sourcePolicy.notes: All review media is original local SVG data embedded in typed fixtures. style_reference and context_only inputs are deliberately rejected by the renderer.

knownLimitations: Shared registry and Director routing remain untouched because they are outside this ownership slice.
16:9 support is metadata-ready only; this task renders portrait review frames only.
Stable promotion requires human visual approval.
